an5.54:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu jiṇṇo hoti jarāya abhibhūto.
an5.54:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu vyādhito hoti vyādhiyābhibhūto.
an5.54:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave dubbhikkhaṃ hoti dussassaṃ dullabhapiṇḍaṃ, na sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
an5.54:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhayaṃ hoti aṭavīsaṃkhepo, cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti.
an5.54:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave saṅgho bhinno hoti,
an5.54:5.2: saṅghe kho pana bhikkhave bhinne aññamaññaṃ akkosā ca honti, aññamaññaṃ paribhāsā ca honti, aññamaññaṃ parikkhepā ca honti, aññamaññaṃ pariccajanā ca honti,
an5.54:5.3: tattha appasannā c'eva na ppasīdanti pasannānañ ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattaṃ hoti.
an5.54:5.5: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca asamayā padhānāya. 7.
an5.54:6.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu daharo hoti yuvā susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā.
an5.54:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu appābādho hoti appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya.
an5.54:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave subhikkhaṃ hoti susassaṃ sulabhapiṇḍaṃ, sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
an5.54:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave manussā samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti.
an5.54:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave saṅgho samaggo sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharati,
an5.54:10.2: saṅghe kho pana bhikkhave samagge na c'eva aññamaññaṃ akkosā honti na ca aññamaññaṃ paribhāsā honti na ca aññamaññaṃ parikkhepā honti na ca aññamaññaṃ pariccajanā honti,
an5.54:10.3: tattha appasannā c'eva pasīdanti pasannānañ ca bhīyobhāvo hoti.
an5.54:10.5: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca samayā padhānāyā
